items.title: Lamar Jackson: Day-to-day, set for tests on ankle
items.description: Jackson (ankle) will undergo an MRI on Monday and is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 24-18 win over the Titans, but the Ravens are hopeful he'll be ready to play Week 5 versus the Falcons, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Set for tests on injured hamstring
items.description:
Barkley will undergo further testing Monday, but the right hamstring injury he sustained in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Rams isn't believed to be "overly serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Remains weeks away from return
items.description:
Tyson (hamstring) is said to be making progress and feeling good but isn't expected to be activated from injured reserve until Week 7 at the soonest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Season-best numbers in loss
items.description:
LaPorta brought in eight of 13 targets for 84 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 32-26 loss to the Panthers on Sunday night.

items.title: Jameson Williams: Eclipses century mark in loss
items.description:
Williams secured six of eight targets for 102 yards in the Lions' 32-26 loss to the Panthers on Sunday night.
